ko.executive_summary: 1.6T optical modules dominate the sector with order backlogs extending into next year, driven by AI data center buildouts. Viavi Solutions, STMicroelectronics, and Qualcomm are capitalizing on surging demand, with STMicroelectronics projecting AI data-center revenue exceeding $2 billion by 2027.
key_facts: 1.6T optical module technology is primary focus for order backlog
STMicroelectronics AI data-center revenue forecast: >$2 billion by 2027
Qualcomm-Amazon AI chip partnership valued at $60 billion
Viavi Solutions rated Buy at $37 target price
Order backlog extends into next year

implications.text: Multi-year order backlog signals sustained supply-chain tightness and manufacturing capacity pressure for 1.6T optical transceiver suppliers.

Optical comms vendors benefiting from AI infrastructure deployment; STMicroelectronics and Viavi positioned to capture margin expansion as data-center optical connectivity becomes critical infrastructure.
Large-scale partnerships (Qualcomm-Amazon) indicate consolidation around AI chip-plus-optics ecosystems, raising barriers for standalone optical-module players.

ko.counterpoint: Backlog strength does not guarantee profitability or margin sustainability if component costs rise or hyperscaler capex cycles cool.
